patches.name: Battle speed
patches.description: The battle speed button switches between 1x and a faster speed instead of 1x and 2x.

options.description: The speed the battle speed button switches to. 2x is the game's own.

patches.name: Bug fixes
patches.description: Fixes for bugs of the original game. Each fix can be switched off in the options.

options.description: On screens wider than 19.5:9 the story-room camera stopped short of the room's end, so a story trigger at the end of the room could not be reached.

patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics
patches.description: Turns off Adjust, Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, Facebook app events, the unused ad SDKs and the engine's Unity Connect contact. None of them are useful on a private server.

patches.name: Frame rate
patches.description: Raises the frame rate cap above the game's 30. The power saving presets stay at 10.

options.description: The frame rate cap. 30 is the game's own.

patches.name: News shown once
patches.description: News pop-ups an account has already seen are never shown again, however long the account was away.

patches.name: Purchases through private server
patches.description: Routes in-app purchases to the private server instead of Google Play billing, which no longer sells anything for this game. Meant to be used with Redirect to private server.

patches.name: Redirect to private server
patches.description: Redirects all network traffic to a private server and routes in-app purchases to it, since the official servers and store shut down in 2024.

options.description: http also enables cleartext traffic in the manifest and turns the game's TLS off for gRPC. https keeps TLS on, so the server needs a certificate the game trusts (e.g. behind Cloudflare).
Hostname or IP of your server, without protocol or port.
Leave empty for the default port (80 or 443 depending on protocol).
Only change this if your server uses a non-standard gRPC port.

patches.name: Roulette without ads
patches.description: The daily gem roulette spins straight away instead of playing an IronSource video ad, and the IronSource SDK never starts.

patches.name: Start without Google Play services
patches.description: Makes Firebase's Google Play services check pass, so the game starts on phones and emulators without them (otherwise it stays black after the logo). Makes no difference on a phone that has them.
